content.short: European issuer of EURR and USDR, fully reserved euro and dollar stablecoins.
content.description: StablR issues EURR, a euro stablecoin, and USDR, a dollar stablecoin, both 100% backed by reserves held in segregated accounts at major financial institutions, with proof of reserves published for EURR. About 11 million EURR are in circulation. The tokens run on Ethereum and Solana and are listed on exchanges, and EURR is also used on Plasma. StablR recently disclosed and contained a security exploit.
content.meta: StablR issues EURR and USDR, reserve-backed euro and dollar stablecoins with published proof of reserves.
